illustration.description: Flat cartoon illustration with bold dark outlines and soft cel shading. A smiling young boy with short tousled brown hair, rosy cheeks, and a calm content expression sits at a table, wearing a green crew-neck t-shirt. On the table in front of him is a white oval plate with grilled chicken breast, a small pile of green broccoli, a red tomato, and a little rice. To the left sits a glass of cool blue water, and a silver fork lies to the right of the plate. The table is a light peach-colored surface with a thin dark edge line, set against a plain white background.
